opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based organisations or institutions; applicants must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration; excludes individuals without such affiliation, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, PhD‑only projects, and establishment of academic posts.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research addressing any of the Foundation’s five priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review. Two application rounds per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based researchers and organisations, with a strong encouragement for applicants from racially minoritised communities and partnership projects involving those communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on the 2026 priority theme of inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK. Grants range from £15,000 to £500,000.
